method: Fresh expert-anchored SAC with geometry_v1 counterfactual training labels on current structured training states. Pure network policy at driving time; no geometric/expert controller override. Uses existing frozen attention/RSSM and 25% synthetic replay.
teacher_provenance: Observed-state pursuit, conservative curvature speed, observed lead/pedestrian clearance and red/yellow stopping. Labels are counterfactual teacher requests, not measured actions. Dynamics/critic replay retains real executed actions/rewards.
motivation: Experiment002 succeeds in both FogNight development routes but collides in seven other drives. Test whether explicit cornering/following-speed training targets improve reliability. No final outcomes used.
final_plan: Same untouched 50 scenarios fixed before experiment001.

new_collision_evidence.finding: Episodes110,113,115 collide with stopped lead vehicles. Immediately before collision the expert requests brake0.5 while ego forward speeds are about5.60,5.65,2.12m/s and bumper clearances are approximately0.00,0.01,0.30m. Conservative earlier following-speed labels are intended to address this, but actual development performance is unproven.

reason: Live physics readout showed the approximate geometry_v1 steering-angle denominator was too small. Retain this trained artifact, but prioritize calibrated geometry_v2 before spending driving evaluation budget. No driving-performance claim is made for experiment004.
